name: Oribe Yasunaga
source:
Occupation: Student
Stay as: Dweller

Yasunaga is a high school student with a highly analytical mind. He is the leader of the group of Yasumizu high schoolers.

He is [url=/c87375]Kaori's[/url] son and [url=/c87411]Yoshitsugu's[/url] brother, currently living in room 102 of the student dorm.

[Taken from the official art book included with the [url=/r65525]Day One Edition[/url].]
